note: Routine mail placed before the target email (one or two per episode). Researcher-authored; not on the drive. None touches a scenario topic (no Call-A-Ride eligibility, bus maintenance or inspections, Route 06 or the Canyon Bench extension, Sunday service, or the Phase 1 stop pads). The bulk agent should make sure ordinary drive files answer them: bike rack policy (and the three-bike rack test), operator compliment process, board meeting schedule and public comment rules (the Oct 28 agenda exists), lost and found procedure, zero-fare policy, snow removal at stops (contract standard), bus advertising contact and rates, Route 12 on-time performance or a detour/construction note, the neighborhood council invitation (GM calendar), route study survey and pop-ups, operator hiring and CDL training, holiday schedule (Thanksgiving Day no service, Friday normal).

emails.name: Sam Whitaker
emails.body: Can I bring my bike on the bus if the rack on the front is full? Happened twice this week on the 1. Thanks

emails.name: Marilyn Eames
emails.body:
I just want to say the driver on the 12 this morning around 7:20 helped an older man with his walker all the way to his seat and waited until he sat down. Nobody does that anymore. Please tell him thank you from all of us on that bus.

Marilyn

emails.name: Kevin Larsen
emails.body:
When is your next board meeting and how do I sign up to speak? Is it in person only or can I call in?

Kevin Larsen

emails.name: Priya Raman
emails.body: Hi! I left a gray backpack with a laptop in it on the Green Loop on Friday afternoon around 4:30, I think I got off at the library. Has anyone turned it in? Where would I pick it up? Thank you so much!!

emails.name: Doug Barlow
emails.body:
I keep hearing other cities are starting to charge fares again. I hope Connect never does. I'm retired and I ride free every day and it's the best thing about living here. Please keep it zero fare. That's all.

Doug

emails.name: Helen Crowther
emails.body: Last winter the stop at 1000 North and 400 West was a wall of snow after every storm because the plows pushed it all onto the corner. Who clears the bus stops and how fast? I'd like to know before the first storm this year.

emails.name: Brett Haacke
emails.body:
Hello, our dental office would like to advertise on the outside of your buses. Who do I contact about rates and sizes?

Brett Haacke, Office Manager

emails.name: Ashley Nielson
emails.body: the 12 has been 10-15 min late almost every morning this month at Center and 100 W and I've been late to work 3 times. is there construction or something? its getting old

emails.name: Rachel Fonnesbeck
emails.address: Logan Neighborhood Council, 64 N. 400 W., Logan, UT 84321
emails.body:
Dear Ms. Whitcomb,

Welcome to Cache Valley! Our neighborhood council meets the second Tuesday of each month at 7 p.m. at the library. We would love to have you come in November or December to introduce yourself and talk about the route study. Would either month work?

Rachel Fonnesbeck, chair

emails.name: Miguel Ortiz
emails.body:
I heard there is a survey about new routes. Where can I take it? I want to ask for a bus that goes out by the new warehouses on 1000 West in the evenings.

Miguel

emails.name: Tyler Rasband
emails.body: Do you need a CDL already to apply to drive a bus? I'm 23 and have a clean record. How long is the training and is it paid?

emails.name: Joan Stauffer
emails.body:
Will the buses run on Thanksgiving and the day after? My daughter works at the mall Friday and I want to know if she can take the bus.

Thanks, Joan
